QF.id: SIA Social Stock Exchange Introduction and Instruments_36

question.text: In the SSE ecosystem, Trading Members provide platforms for donation via which of the following channels?

answer.text: Only cash deposits at the exchange counter.
Demand drafts and bearer cheques only.
Application Supported by Blocked Amounts (ASBA) and Unified Payment Interface (UPI) based donations.

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 2.2.1, 'It is through these trading members that an individual will be able to buy securities of NPOs and FPEs listed on SSE. They provide platform for Application Supported by Blocked Amounts (ASBA) and Unified Payment Interface (UPI) based donations.' ASBA is the standard IPO payment mechanism; UPI extends retail access. The Trap: Option A (cash) would violate AML/KYC norms for securities subscription. Options B and D are obsolete or non-compliant instruments for the SSE flow. Cross-Exam Context: XII (SMF) Ch 1 treats ASBA in conventional IPOs. V-B (MF Foundation) treats UPI-based MF subscription — same rail, donation context. Assessor's Pro-Tip: When reconciling a ZCZP public-issue subscription, pull both the ASBA bank block report and the UPI mandate log from the registrar — mismatches here (subscription blocked but ZCZP not allocated) create investor-complaint exposure for the NPO that the SIA should flag.
